intentions: Define a Category model with unique name, optional description and reorder threshold
Define a Product model with unique SKU, foreign key to category, price in cents, stock quantity, and optional low_active flag
Implement a CategoryRepository with SQLite storage supporting CRUD operations and fetching all products in a category
Implement a ProductRepository with SQLite storage supporting CRUD, filtering by category, identifying low-stock items, and aggregating stock value by category
Develop an InventoryService with business logic for product and category operations including validation, updates, deletions, and reporting
Build a CLI interface using Click with nested command groups for product and category management
Ensure all monetary values are stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point inaccuracies
Use auto-incremented primary keys for IDs with optional default values in domain models
Enable foreign key constraints in SQLite database schema
Implement custom exception classes for CategoryNotFoundError and ProductNotFoundError
Provide comprehensive error handling across all service and CLI operations
